- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.

47	func SaveAttachmentBlob(ctx context.Context, profile *profile.Profile, stores *store.Store, create *store.Attachment) error {

50			return errors.Wrap(err, "Failed to find instance storage setting")

69				osPath = filepath.Join(profile.Data, osPath)

74				internalPath, err = filepath.Rel(profile.Data, osPath)

78				internalPath = filepath.ToSlash(internalPath)

133	func (s *APIV1Service) GetAttachmentBlob(attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
134		// For local storage, read the file from the local disk.
135		if attachment.StorageType == storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL {
136			attachmentPath := filepath.FromSlash(attachment.Reference)
137			if !filepath.IsAbs(attachmentPath) {
138				attachmentPath = filepath.Join(s.Profile.Data, attachmentPath)
139			}
140	
141			file, err := os.Open(attachmentPath)
142			if err != nil {
143				if os.IsNotExist(err) {
144					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "file not found")
145				}
146				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open the file")
147			}
148			defer file.Close()
149			blob, err := io.ReadAll(file)
150			if err != nil {
151				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read the file")
152			}
153			return blob, nil
154		}
155		// For S3 storage, download the file from S3.
156		if attachment.StorageType == storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3 {
157			if attachment.Payload == nil {
158				return nil, errors.New("attachment payload is missing")
159			}
160			s3Object := attachment.Payload.GetS3Object()
161			if s3Object == nil {
162				return nil, errors.New("S3 object payload is missing")
163			}
164			if s3Object.S3Config == nil {
165				return nil, errors.New("S3 config is missing")
166			}
167			if s3Object.Key == "" {
168				return nil, errors.New("S3 object key is missing")
169			}
170	
171			s3Client, err := s3.NewClient(context.Background(), s3Object.S3Config)
172			if err != nil {
173				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create S3 client")
174			}
175	
176			blob, err := s3Client.GetObject(context.Background(), s3Object.Key)
177			if err != nil {
178				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get object from S3")
179			}
180			return blob, nil
181		}
182		// For database storage, return the blob from the database.
183		return attachment.Blob, nil
184	}

188	func replaceFilenameWithPathTemplate(path, filename string) string {
189		t := time.Now()
190		path = fileKeyPattern.ReplaceAllStringFunc(path, func(s string) string {
191			switch s {
192			case "{filename}":
193				return filename
194			case "{timestamp}":
195				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", t.Unix())
196			case "{year}":
197				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", t.Year())
198			case "{month}":
199				return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", t.Month())
200			case "{day}":
201				return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", t.Day())
202			case "{hour}":
203				return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", t.Hour())
204			case "{minute}":
205				return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", t.Minute())
206			case "{second}":
207				return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", t.Second())
208			case "{uuid}":
209				return util.GenUUID()

211				return s

228		// Reject path traversal attempts and make sure no additional directories are created
229		if !filepath.IsLocal(filename) || strings.ContainsAny(filename, "/\\") {
230			return false
231		}

233		// Reject filenames starting or ending with spaces or periods
234		if strings.HasPrefix(filename, " ") || strings.HasSuffix(filename, " ") ||
235			strings.HasPrefix(filename, ".") || strings.HasSuffix(filename, ".") {
236			return false
237		}

239		return true

16	type Runner struct {

20	func NewRunner(store *store.Store) *Runner {
21		return &Runner{
22			Store: store,
23		}
24	}

26	// Schedule runner every 12 hours.
27	const runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12
28	
29	func (r *Runner) Run(ctx context.Context) {
30		ticker := time.NewTicker(runnerInterval)
31		defer ticker.Stop()
32	
33		for {
34			select {
35			case <-ticker.C:
36				r.RunOnce(ctx)
37			case <-ctx.Done():
38				return
39			}
40		}
41	}

43	func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context) {
44		r.CheckAndPresign(ctx)
45	}

47	func (r *Runner) CheckAndPresign(ctx context.Context) {
48		instanceStorageSetting, err := r.Store.GetInstanceStorageSetting(ctx)
49		if err != nil {
50			return
51		}
52	
53		s3StorageType := storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3
54		// Limit attachments to a reasonable batch size
55		const batchSize = 100
56		offset := 0
57	
58		for {
59			limit := batchSize
60			attachments, err := r.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
61				GetBlob:     false,
62				StorageType: &s3StorageType,
63				Limit:       &limit,
64				Offset:      &offset,
65			})
66			if err != nil {
67				slog.Error("Failed to list attachments for presigning", "error", err)
68				return
69			}
70	
71			// Break if no more attachments
72			if len(attachments) == 0 {
73				break
74			}
75	
76			// Process batch of attachments
77			presignCount := 0
78			for _, attachment := range attachments {
79				payload := cloneAttachmentPayload(attachment.Payload)
80				s3ObjectPayload := payload.GetS3Object()
81				if s3ObjectPayload == nil {
82					continue
83				}
84	
85				if s3ObjectPayload.LastPresignedTime != nil {
86					// Skip if the presigned URL is still valid for the next 4 days.
87					// The expiration time is set to 5 days.
88					if time.Now().Before(s3ObjectPayload.LastPresignedTime.AsTime().Add(4 * 24 * time.Hour)) {
89						continue
90					}
91				}
92	
93				s3Config := instanceStorageSetting.GetS3Config()
94				if s3ObjectPayload.S3Config != nil {
95					s3Config = s3ObjectPayload.S3Config
96				}
97				if s3Config == nil {
98					slog.Error("S3 config is not found")
99					continue
100				}
101	
102				s3Client, err := s3.NewClient(ctx, s3Config)
103				if err != nil {
104					slog.Error("Failed to create S3 client", "error", err)
105					continue
106				}
107	
108				presignURL, err := s3Client.PresignGetObject(ctx, s3ObjectPayload.Key)
109				if err != nil {
110					slog.Error("Failed to presign URL", "error", err, "attachmentID", attachment.ID)
111					continue
112				}
113	
114				s3ObjectPayload.S3Config = s3Config
115				s3ObjectPayload.LastPresignedTime = timestamppb.New(time.Now())

117					ID:        attachment.ID,
118					Reference: &presignURL,
119					Payload:   payload,
120				}); err != nil {
121					slog.Error("Failed to update attachment", "error", err, "attachmentID", attachment.ID)
122					continue
123				}
124				presignCount++
125			}

130			offset += len(attachments)

11	// Scheduler manages scheduled jobs.
12	type Scheduler struct {
13		jobs       map[string]*registeredJob
14		jobsMu     sync.RWMutex
15		timezone   *time.Location
16		middleware Middleware
17		running    bool

23	// registeredJob wraps a Job with runtime state.
24	type registeredJob struct {

32	// WithTimezone sets the default timezone for all jobs.
33	func WithTimezone(tz string) Option {
34		return func(s *Scheduler) {
35			loc, err := time.LoadLocation(tz)
36			if err != nil {
37				// Default to UTC on invalid timezone
38				loc = time.UTC
39			}
40			s.timezone = loc
41		}
42	}

48				s.middleware = Chain(mw...)

50		}
51	}

57			timezone: time.UTC,

59		}

61		for _, opt := range opts {

68	// Register adds a job to the scheduler.
69	// Jobs must be registered before calling Start().
70	func (s *Scheduler) Register(job *Job) error {
71		if job == nil {
72			return errors.New("job cannot be nil")
73		}
74	
75		if err := job.Validate(); err != nil {
76			return errors.Wrap(err, "invalid job")
77		}
78	
79		s.jobsMu.Lock()
80		defer s.jobsMu.Unlock()
81	
82		if _, exists := s.jobs[job.Name]; exists {
83			return errors.Errorf("job with name %q already registered", job.Name)
84		}
85	
86		s.jobs[job.Name] = &registeredJob{job: job}
87		return nil
88	}

90	// Start begins executing scheduled jobs.
91	func (s *Scheduler) Start() error {
92		s.runningMu.Lock()
93		defer s.runningMu.Unlock()
94	
95		if s.running {
96			return errors.New("scheduler already running")
97		}
98	
99		s.jobsMu.RLock()
100		defer s.jobsMu.RUnlock()
101	
102		// Parse and schedule all jobs
103		for _, rj := range s.jobs {
104			schedule, err := ParseCronExpression(rj.job.Schedule)
105			if err != nil {
106				return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to parse schedule for job %q", rj.job.Name)
107			}
108	
109			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
110			rj.cancelFn = cancel
111	
112			s.wg.Add(1)
113			go s.runJobWithSchedule(ctx, rj, schedule)
114		}
115	
116		s.running = true
117		return nil
118	}

120	// runJobWithSchedule executes a job according to its cron schedule.
121	func (s *Scheduler) runJobWithSchedule(ctx context.Context, rj *registeredJob, schedule *Schedule) {
122		defer s.wg.Done()
123	
124		// Apply middleware to handler
125		handler := rj.job.Handler
126		if s.middleware != nil {
127			handler = s.middleware(handler)
128		}
129	
130		for {
131			// Calculate next run time
132			now := time.Now()
133			if rj.job.Timezone != "" {
134				loc, err := time.LoadLocation(rj.job.Timezone)
135				if err == nil {
136					now = now.In(loc)
137				}
138			} else if s.timezone != nil {
139				now = now.In(s.timezone)
140			}
141	
142			next := schedule.Next(now)
143			duration := time.Until(next)
144	
145			timer := time.NewTimer(duration)
146	
147			select {
148			case <-timer.C:
149				// Add job name to context and execute
150				jobCtx := withJobName(ctx, rj.job.Name)
151				if err := handler(jobCtx); err != nil {
152					// Error already handled by middleware (if any)
153					_ = err
154				}
155			case <-ctx.Done():
156				// Stop the timer to prevent it from firing. The timer will be garbage collected.
157				timer.Stop()
158				return
159			case <-s.stopCh:
160				// Stop the timer to prevent it from firing. The timer will be garbage collected.
161				timer.Stop()
162				return
163			}
164		}
165	}

167	// Stop gracefully shuts down the scheduler.
168	// It waits for all running jobs to complete or until the context is canceled.
169	func (s *Scheduler) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
170		s.runningMu.Lock()
171		if !s.running {
172			s.runningMu.Unlock()
173			return errors.New("scheduler not running")
174		}
175		s.running = false
176		s.runningMu.Unlock()
177	
178		// Cancel all job contexts
179		s.jobsMu.RLock()
180		for _, rj := range s.jobs {
181			if rj.cancelFn != nil {
182				rj.cancelFn()
183			}
184		}
185		s.jobsMu.RUnlock()
186	
187		// Signal stop and wait for jobs to finish
188		close(s.stopCh)
189	
190		done := make(chan struct{})
191		go func() {
192			s.wg.Wait()
193			close(done)
194		}()
195	
196		select {
197		case <-done:
198			return nil
199		case <-ctx.Done():
200			return ctx.Err()
201		}
202	}

47	func SaveAttachmentBlob(ctx context.Context, profile *profile.Profile, stores *store.Store, create *store.Attachment) error {
48		instanceStorageSetting, err := stores.GetInstanceStorageSetting(ctx)
49		if err != nil {
50			return errors.Wrap(err, "Failed to find instance storage setting")
51		}
52	
53		if instanceStorageSetting.StorageType == storepb.InstanceStorageSetting_LOCAL {
54			filepathTemplate := "assets/{timestamp}_{uuid}_{filename}"

59			internalPath := filepathTemplate

61				internalPath = filepath.Join(internalPath, "{filename}")

63			internalPath = replaceFilenameWithPathTemplate(internalPath, create.Filename)
64			internalPath = filepath.ToSlash(internalPath)
65	
66			// Ensure the directory exists.
67			osPath := filepath.FromSlash(internalPath)
68			if !filepath.IsAbs(osPath) {
69				osPath = filepath.Join(profile.Data, osPath)
70			}
71			osPath = ensureUniqueLocalAttachmentPath(osPath, create.UID)
72			internalPath = filepath.ToSlash(osPath)
73			if !filepath.IsAbs(filepath.FromSlash(internalPath)) {
74				internalPath, err = filepath.Rel(profile.Data, osPath)
75				if err != nil {
76					return errors.Wrap(err, "Failed to get relative path")
77				}
78				internalPath = filepath.ToSlash(internalPath)
79			}
80			dir := filepath.Dir(osPath)
81			if err = os.MkdirAll(dir, os.ModePerm); err != nil {
82				return errors.Wrap(err, "Failed to create directory")
83			}
84	
85			// Write the blob to the file.
86			if err := os.WriteFile(osPath, create.Blob, 0644); err != nil {
87				return errors.Wrap(err, "Failed to write file")
88			}
89			create.Reference = internalPath
90			create.Blob = nil
91			create.StorageType = storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL
92		} else if instanceStorageSetting.StorageType == storepb.InstanceStorageSetting_S3 {
93			s3Config := instanceStorageSetting.S3Config

113				return errors.Wrap(err, "Failed to presign via s3 client")
114			}
115	
116			create.Reference = presignURL
117			create.Blob = nil
118			create.StorageType = storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3
119			payload := ensureAttachmentPayload(create.Payload)
120			payload.Payload = &storepb.AttachmentPayload_S3Object_{
121				S3Object: &storepb.AttachmentPayload_S3Object{

133	func (s *APIV1Service) GetAttachmentBlob(attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
134		// For local storage, read the file from the local disk.
135		if attachment.StorageType == storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL {
136			attachmentPath := filepath.FromSlash(attachment.Reference)
137			if !filepath.IsAbs(attachmentPath) {
138				attachmentPath = filepath.Join(s.Profile.Data, attachmentPath)
139			}
140	
141			file, err := os.Open(attachmentPath)
142			if err != nil {
143				if os.IsNotExist(err) {
144					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "file not found")
145				}
146				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open the file")
147			}
148			defer file.Close()
149			blob, err := io.ReadAll(file)
150			if err != nil {
151				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read the file")
152			}
153			return blob, nil
154		}
155		// For S3 storage, download the file from S3.
156		if attachment.StorageType == storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3 {
157			if attachment.Payload == nil {
158				return nil, errors.New("attachment payload is missing")
159			}
160			s3Object := attachment.Payload.GetS3Object()
161			if s3Object == nil {
162				return nil, errors.New("S3 object payload is missing")
163			}
164			if s3Object.S3Config == nil {
165				return nil, errors.New("S3 config is missing")
166			}
167			if s3Object.Key == "" {
168				return nil, errors.New("S3 object key is missing")
169			}
170	
171			s3Client, err := s3.NewClient(context.Background(), s3Object.S3Config)
172			if err != nil {
173				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create S3 client")
174			}
175	
176			blob, err := s3Client.GetObject(context.Background(), s3Object.Key)
177			if err != nil {
178				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get object from S3")
179			}
180			return blob, nil
181		}
182		// For database storage, return the blob from the database.
183		return attachment.Blob, nil
184	}

188	func replaceFilenameWithPathTemplate(path, filename string) string {
189		t := time.Now()
190		path = fileKeyPattern.ReplaceAllStringFunc(path, func(s string) string {
191			switch s {
192			case "{filename}":
193				return filename
194			case "{timestamp}":
195				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", t.Unix())
196			case "{year}":
197				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", t.Year())
198			case "{month}":
199				return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", t.Month())
200			case "{day}":
201				return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", t.Day())
202			case "{hour}":
203				return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", t.Hour())
204			case "{minute}":
205				return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", t.Minute())
206			case "{second}":
207				return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", t.Second())
208			case "{uuid}":
209				return util.GenUUID()
210			default:
211				return s
212			}
213		})
214		return path
215	}

218		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err != nil {

222		ext := filepath.Ext(path)

227	func validateFilename(filename string) bool {
228		// Reject path traversal attempts and make sure no additional directories are created
229		if !filepath.IsLocal(filename) || strings.ContainsAny(filename, "/\\") {
230			return false
231		}
232	
233		// Reject filenames starting or ending with spaces or periods
234		if strings.HasPrefix(filename, " ") || strings.HasSuffix(filename, " ") ||
235			strings.HasPrefix(filename, ".") || strings.HasSuffix(filename, ".") {
236			return false
237		}
238	
239		return true
240	}

243		mimeType = strings.TrimSpace(mimeType)
244		if mimeType == "" || len(mimeType) > 255 {

16	type Runner struct {

20	func NewRunner(store *store.Store) *Runner {
21		return &Runner{
22			Store: store,
23		}
24	}

26	// Schedule runner every 12 hours.
27	const runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12
28	
29	func (r *Runner) Run(ctx context.Context) {
30		ticker := time.NewTicker(runnerInterval)
31		defer ticker.Stop()
32	
33		for {
34			select {
35			case <-ticker.C:
36				r.RunOnce(ctx)
37			case <-ctx.Done():
38				return
39			}
40		}
41	}

43	func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context) {
44		r.CheckAndPresign(ctx)
45	}

47	func (r *Runner) CheckAndPresign(ctx context.Context) {
48		instanceStorageSetting, err := r.Store.GetInstanceStorageSetting(ctx)
49		if err != nil {
50			return
51		}
52	
53		s3StorageType := storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3
54		// Limit attachments to a reasonable batch size
55		const batchSize = 100
56		offset := 0
57	
58		for {
59			limit := batchSize
60			attachments, err := r.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
61				GetBlob:     false,
62				StorageType: &s3StorageType,
63				Limit:       &limit,
64				Offset:      &offset,
65			})
66			if err != nil {
67				slog.Error("Failed to list attachments for presigning", "error", err)
68				return
69			}
70	
71			// Break if no more attachments
72			if len(attachments) == 0 {
73				break
74			}
75	
76			// Process batch of attachments
77			presignCount := 0
78			for _, attachment := range attachments {
79				payload := cloneAttachmentPayload(attachment.Payload)
80				s3ObjectPayload := payload.GetS3Object()
81				if s3ObjectPayload == nil {
82					continue
83				}
84	
85				if s3ObjectPayload.LastPresignedTime != nil {
86					// Skip if the presigned URL is still valid for the next 4 days.
87					// The expiration time is set to 5 days.
88					if time.Now().Before(s3ObjectPayload.LastPresignedTime.AsTime().Add(4 * 24 * time.Hour)) {
89						continue
90					}
91				}
92	
93				s3Config := instanceStorageSetting.GetS3Config()
94				if s3ObjectPayload.S3Config != nil {
95					s3Config = s3ObjectPayload.S3Config
96				}
97				if s3Config == nil {
98					slog.Error("S3 config is not found")
99					continue
100				}
101	
102				s3Client, err := s3.NewClient(ctx, s3Config)
103				if err != nil {
104					slog.Error("Failed to create S3 client", "error", err)
105					continue
106				}
107	
108				presignURL, err := s3Client.PresignGetObject(ctx, s3ObjectPayload.Key)
109				if err != nil {
110					slog.Error("Failed to presign URL", "error", err, "attachmentID", attachment.ID)
111					continue
112				}
113	
114				s3ObjectPayload.S3Config = s3Config
115				s3ObjectPayload.LastPresignedTime = timestamppb.New(time.Now())

117					ID:        attachment.ID,
118					Reference: &presignURL,
119					Payload:   payload,
120				}); err != nil {
121					slog.Error("Failed to update attachment", "error", err, "attachmentID", attachment.ID)
122					continue
123				}
124				presignCount++
125			}

130			offset += len(attachments)

11	// Scheduler manages scheduled jobs.
12	type Scheduler struct {
13		jobs       map[string]*registeredJob
14		jobsMu     sync.RWMutex
15		timezone   *time.Location
16		middleware Middleware
17		running    bool

23	// registeredJob wraps a Job with runtime state.
24	type registeredJob struct {

32	// WithTimezone sets the default timezone for all jobs.
33	func WithTimezone(tz string) Option {
34		return func(s *Scheduler) {
35			loc, err := time.LoadLocation(tz)
36			if err != nil {
37				// Default to UTC on invalid timezone
38				loc = time.UTC
39			}
40			s.timezone = loc
41		}
42	}

48				s.middleware = Chain(mw...)

50		}
51	}

57			timezone: time.UTC,

59		}

61		for _, opt := range opts {

68	// Register adds a job to the scheduler.
69	// Jobs must be registered before calling Start().
70	func (s *Scheduler) Register(job *Job) error {
71		if job == nil {
72			return errors.New("job cannot be nil")
73		}
74	
75		if err := job.Validate(); err != nil {
76			return errors.Wrap(err, "invalid job")
77		}
78	
79		s.jobsMu.Lock()
80		defer s.jobsMu.Unlock()
81	
82		if _, exists := s.jobs[job.Name]; exists {
83			return errors.Errorf("job with name %q already registered", job.Name)
84		}
85	
86		s.jobs[job.Name] = &registeredJob{job: job}
87		return nil
88	}

90	// Start begins executing scheduled jobs.
91	func (s *Scheduler) Start() error {
92		s.runningMu.Lock()
93		defer s.runningMu.Unlock()
94	
95		if s.running {
96			return errors.New("scheduler already running")
97		}
98	
99		s.jobsMu.RLock()
100		defer s.jobsMu.RUnlock()
101	
102		// Parse and schedule all jobs
103		for _, rj := range s.jobs {
104			schedule, err := ParseCronExpression(rj.job.Schedule)
105			if err != nil {
106				return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to parse schedule for job %q", rj.job.Name)
107			}
108	
109			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
110			rj.cancelFn = cancel
111	
112			s.wg.Add(1)
113			go s.runJobWithSchedule(ctx, rj, schedule)
114		}
115	
116		s.running = true
117		return nil
118	}

120	// runJobWithSchedule executes a job according to its cron schedule.
121	func (s *Scheduler) runJobWithSchedule(ctx context.Context, rj *registeredJob, schedule *Schedule) {
122		defer s.wg.Done()
123	
124		// Apply middleware to handler
125		handler := rj.job.Handler
126		if s.middleware != nil {
127			handler = s.middleware(handler)
128		}
129	
130		for {
131			// Calculate next run time
132			now := time.Now()
133			if rj.job.Timezone != "" {
134				loc, err := time.LoadLocation(rj.job.Timezone)
135				if err == nil {
136					now = now.In(loc)
137				}
138			} else if s.timezone != nil {
139				now = now.In(s.timezone)
140			}
141	
142			next := schedule.Next(now)
143			duration := time.Until(next)
144	
145			timer := time.NewTimer(duration)
146	
147			select {
148			case <-timer.C:
149				// Add job name to context and execute
150				jobCtx := withJobName(ctx, rj.job.Name)
151				if err := handler(jobCtx); err != nil {
152					// Error already handled by middleware (if any)
153					_ = err
154				}
155			case <-ctx.Done():
156				// Stop the timer to prevent it from firing. The timer will be garbage collected.
157				timer.Stop()
158				return
159			case <-s.stopCh:
160				// Stop the timer to prevent it from firing. The timer will be garbage collected.
161				timer.Stop()
162				return
163			}
164		}
165	}

167	// Stop gracefully shuts down the scheduler.
168	// It waits for all running jobs to complete or until the context is canceled.
169	func (s *Scheduler) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
170		s.runningMu.Lock()
171		if !s.running {
172			s.runningMu.Unlock()
173			return errors.New("scheduler not running")
174		}
175		s.running = false
176		s.runningMu.Unlock()
177	
178		// Cancel all job contexts
179		s.jobsMu.RLock()
180		for _, rj := range s.jobs {
181			if rj.cancelFn != nil {
182				rj.cancelFn()
183			}
184		}
185		s.jobsMu.RUnlock()
186	
187		// Signal stop and wait for jobs to finish
188		close(s.stopCh)
189	
190		done := make(chan struct{})
191		go func() {
192			s.wg.Wait()
193			close(done)
194		}()
195	
196		select {
197		case <-done:
198			return nil
199		case <-ctx.Done():
200			return ctx.Err()
201		}
202	}

51	func (c *Client) Send(message *Message) error {
52		// Validate configuration
53		if err := c.validateConfig(); err != nil {
54			return errors.Wrap(err, "invalid email configuration")
55		}
56	
57		// Validate message
58		if message == nil {
59			return errors.New("message is required")
60		}
61		if err := message.Validate(); err != nil {
62			return errors.Wrap(err, "invalid email message")
63		}
64	
65		// Format the message
66		body := message.Format(c.config.FromEmail, c.config.FromName)
67	
68		// Get all recipients
69		recipients := message.GetAllRecipients()
70	
71		// Create auth
72		auth := c.createAuth()
73	
74		// Send based on encryption type
75		if c.config.UseSSL {
76			return c.sendWithSSL(auth, recipients, body)
77		}
78		return c.sendWithTLS(auth, recipients, body)
79	}

81	// sendWithTLS sends email using STARTTLS (port 587).
82	func (c *Client) sendWithTLS(auth smtp.Auth, recipients []string, body string) error {
83		serverAddr := c.config.GetServerAddress()
84	
85		dialer := &net.Dialer{Timeout: smtpOperationTimeout}
86		conn, err := dialer.Dial("tcp", serverAddr)
87		if err != nil {
88			return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to connect to SMTP server: %s", serverAddr)
89		}
90		defer conn.Close()
91		if err := conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(smtpOperationTimeout)); err != nil {
92			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set SMTP connection deadline")
93		}
94	
95		client, err := smtp.NewClient(conn, c.config.SMTPHost)
96		if err != nil {
97			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create SMTP client")
98		}
99		defer client.Quit()
100	
101		if c.config.UseTLS {
102			if ok, _ := client.Extension("STARTTLS"); !ok {
103				return errors.New("SMTP server does not support STARTTLS")
104			}
105			if err := client.StartTLS(c.createTLSConfig()); err != nil {
106				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to start SMTP STARTTLS")
107			}
108		}
109

133		}

139	func (c *Client) sendWithClient(client *smtp.Client, auth smtp.Auth, recipients []string, body string) error {
140		if auth != nil {

142				return errors.Wrap(err, "SMTP authentication failed")

148			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set sender")

150	
151		// Set recipients
152		for _, recipient := range recipients {
153			if err := client.Rcpt(recipient); err != nil {
154				return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to set recipient: %s", recipient)
155			}
156		}
157	
158		// Send message body
159		writer, err := client.Data()
160		if err != nil {
161			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to send DATA command")
162		}
163	
164		if _, err := writer.Write([]byte(body)); err != nil {
165			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to write message body")
166		}
167

92	// resolveSigningKey returns the raw HMAC key for a signing secret. Secrets using

107		if request.Webhook == nil {

118		if err != nil {

120		}
121		if currentUser == nil {
122			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
123		}
124		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
125			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
126		}
127	
128		// Get existing webhooks
129		webhooks, err := s.Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, userID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user webhooks: %v", err)
132		}
133	
134		// Find the webhook to update
135		var targetWebhook *storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook
136		for _, webhook := range webhooks {
137			if webhook.Id == webhookID {
138				targetWebhook = webhook
139				break
140			}
141		}
142	
143		if targetWebhook == nil {
144			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "webhook not found")
145		}
146	
147		// Update the webhook
148		updatedWebhook := &storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook{
149			Id:            webhookID,
150			Title:         targetWebhook.Title,
151			Url:           targetWebhook.Url,
152			SigningSecret: targetWebhook.SigningSecret,
153		}
154	
155		if request.UpdateMask != nil {
156			for _, path := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
157				switch path {
158				case "url":
159					if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
160						trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
161						if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
162							return nil, err
163						}
164						updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
165					}
166				case "display_name":
167					updatedWebhook.Title = request.Webhook.DisplayName
168				case "signing_secret":
169					secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
170					if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
171						return nil, err
172					}
173					updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
174				default:
175					// Ignore unsupported fields
176				}
177			}
178		} else {
179			// If no update mask is provided, update all fields
180			if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
181				trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
182				if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
183					return nil, err
184				}
185				updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
186			}
187			updatedWebhook.Title = request.Webhook.DisplayName
188			if request.Webhook.SigningSecret != "" {
189				secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
190				if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
191					return nil, err
192				}
193				updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
194			}
195		}
196	
197		err = s.Store.UpdateUserWebhook(ctx, userID, updatedWebhook)
198		if err != nil {
199			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update webhook: %v", err)
200		}
201	
202		return convertUserWebhookFromUserSetting(updatedWebhook, user), nil
203	}

18	var ErrInternalIP = errors.New("internal IP addresses are not allowed")

31	func newHTTPClient() *http.Client {
32		transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
33		transport.Proxy = nil
34		transport.DialContext = secureDialContext
35	
36		return &http.Client{
37			Transport: transport,
38			Timeout:   5 * time.Second,
39			CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
40				if err := validateURL(req.URL.String()); err != nil {
41					return errors.Wrap(err, "redirect to internal IP")
42				}
43				if len(via) >= 10 {
44					return errors.New("too many redirects")
45				}
46				return nil
47			},
48		}
49	}

51	func secureDialContext(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
52		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(address)
53		if err != nil {
54			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "invalid address")
55		}
56	
57		ips, err := resolveAllowedIPs(ctx, host)
58		if err != nil {
59			return nil, err
60		}
61	
62		var dialErr error
63		for _, ip := range ips {
64			conn, err := dialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(ip.String(), port))
65			if err == nil {
66				return conn, nil
67			}
68			dialErr = err
69		}
70		return nil, dialErr
71	}

73	func resolveAllowedIPs(ctx context.Context, host string) ([]net.IP, error) {
74		if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil {
75			if isInternalIP(ip) {
76				return nil, errors.Wrap(ErrInternalIP, ip.String())
77			}
78			return []net.IP{ip}, nil
79		}
80	
81		addrs, err := lookupIPAddr(ctx, host)
82		if err != nil {
83			return nil, errors.Errorf("failed to resolve hostname: %v", err)
84		}
85	
86		ips := make([]net.IP, 0, len(addrs))
87		for _, addr := range addrs {
88			ip := addr.IP
89			if ip == nil {
90				continue
91			}
92			if isInternalIP(ip) {
93				return nil, errors.Wrapf(ErrInternalIP, "host=%s, ip=%s", host, ip.String())
94			}
95			ips = append(ips, ip)
96		}
97		if len(ips) == 0 {
98			return nil, errors.New("hostname resolved to no addresses")
99		}
100	
101		return ips, nil
102	}

104	func isInternalIP(ip net.IP) bool {
105		return ip.IsLoopback() || ip.IsPrivate() || ip.IsLinkLocalUnicast() || ip.IsUnspecified()
106	}

108	func validateURL(urlStr string) error {
109		u, err := url.Parse(urlStr)
110		if err != nil {
111			return errors.New("invalid URL format")
112		}
113	
114		if u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https" {
115			return errors.New("only http/https protocols are allowed")
116		}
117	
118		host := u.Hostname()
119		if host == "" {
120			return errors.New("empty hostname")
121		}
122	
123		if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil && isInternalIP(ip) {
124			return errors.Wrap(ErrInternalIP, ip.String())
125		}
126	
127		return nil
128	}

130	type HTMLMeta struct {

132		Description string `json:"description"`
133		Image       string `json:"image"`
134	}

136	func GetHTMLMeta(urlStr string) (*HTMLMeta, error) {
137		if err := validateURL(urlStr); err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140	
141		response, err := httpClient.Get(urlStr)
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, err
144		}
145		defer response.Body.Close()
146	
147		mediatype, err := getMediatype(response)
148		if err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151		if mediatype != "text/html" {
152			return nil, errors.New("not a HTML page")
153		}
154	
155		htmlMeta := extractHTMLMeta(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maxHTMLMetaBytes))
156		enrichSiteMeta(response.Request.URL, htmlMeta)
157		return htmlMeta, nil

160	func extractHTMLMeta(resp io.Reader) *HTMLMeta {
161		tokenizer := html.NewTokenizer(resp)
162		htmlMeta := new(HTMLMeta)
163	
164		for {
165			tokenType := tokenizer.Next()
166			if tokenType == html.ErrorToken {
167				break
168			} else if tokenType == html.StartTagToken || tokenType == html.SelfClosingTagToken {
169				token := tokenizer.Token()
170				if token.DataAtom == atom.Body {
171					break
172				}
173	
174				if token.DataAtom == atom.Title {
175					tokenizer.Next()
176					token := tokenizer.Token()
177					htmlMeta.Title = token.Data
178				} else if token.DataAtom == atom.Meta {
179					ogTitle, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "og:title")
180					if ok {
181						htmlMeta.Title = ogTitle
182					}
183	
184					ogDescription, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "og:description")
185					if ok {
186						htmlMeta.Description = ogDescription
187					}
188	
189					ogImage, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "og:image")
190					if ok {
191						htmlMeta.Image = ogImage
192					}
193	
194					description, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "description")
195					if ok && htmlMeta.Description == "" {
196						htmlMeta.Description = description
197					}
198				}
199			}
200		}
201	
202		return htmlMeta
203	}

205	func extractMetaProperty(token html.Token, prop string) (content string, ok bool) {
206		content, ok = "", false
207		for _, attr := range token.Attr {
208			if (attr.Key == "property" || attr.Key == "name") && strings.EqualFold(attr.Val, prop) {
209				ok = true
210			}
211			if attr.Key == "content" {
212				content = attr.Val
213			}
214		}

218	func enrichSiteMeta(url *url.URL, meta *HTMLMeta) {

55				slog.Int64("inbox_id", int64(inbox.ID)),
56				slog.Int64("receiver_id", int64(inbox.ReceiverID)))

58		}
59	
60		receiver, err := d.store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{ID: &inbox.ReceiverID})

62			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get notification receiver")
63		}
64		if receiver == nil || strings.TrimSpace(receiver.Email) == "" {
65			return nil
66		}
67	
68		sender, err := d.store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{ID: &inbox.SenderID})

136	func (d *EmailDispatcher) buildInboxEmailMessage(inbox *store.Inbox, receiver *store.User, sender *store.User, memosByID map[int32]*store.Memo) (*email.Message, error) {
137		senderName := displayNameForEmail(sender)

148	func (d *EmailDispatcher) buildMemoCommentEmailMessage(message *storepb.InboxMessage, receiver *store.User, senderName string, memosByID map[int32]*store.Memo) (*email.Message, error) {
149		payload := message.GetMemoComment()

159		if url == "" {

161		}
162

167			"",
168			"Open in Memos:",
169			url,
170			"",
171			"You are receiving this because you own this memo.",
172		}
173	
174		return &email.Message{

176			Subject: fmt.Sprintf("[Memos] %s commented on your memo", senderName),
177			Body:    strings.Join(body, "\n"),
178		}, nil
179	}

213	func (d *EmailDispatcher) listMemosByID(ctx context.Context, memoIDs []int32) (map[int32]*store.Memo, error) {
214		if len(memoIDs) == 0 {
215			return map[int32]*store.Memo{}, nil
216		}
217	
218		uniqueMemoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memoIDs))
219		seenMemoIDs := make(map[int32]struct{}, len(memoIDs))
220		for _, memoID := range memoIDs {
221			if memoID == 0 {
222				continue
223			}
224			if _, seen := seenMemoIDs[memoID]; seen {
225				continue
226			}
227			seenMemoIDs[memoID] = struct{}{}
228			uniqueMemoIDs = append(uniqueMemoIDs, memoID)
229		}
230		if len(uniqueMemoIDs) == 0 {
231			return map[int32]*store.Memo{}, nil
232		}
233	
234		memos, err := d.store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{IDList: uniqueMemoIDs})
235		if err != nil {
236			return nil, err
237		}
238	
239		memosByID := make(map[int32]*store.Memo, len(memos))
240		for _, memo := range memos {
241			memosByID[memo.ID] = memo
242		}
243		return memosByID, nil
244	}

246	func collectInboxMemoIDs(inboxes []*store.Inbox) []int32 {
247		memoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(inboxes)*2)
248		for _, inbox := range inboxes {
249			if inbox == nil || inbox.Message == nil {
250				continue
251			}
252			switch inbox.Message.Type {
253			case storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT:
254				payload := inbox.Message.GetMemoComment()
255				if payload != nil {
256					memoIDs = append(memoIDs, payload.MemoId, payload.RelatedMemoId)
257				}
258			case storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_MENTION:
259				payload := inbox.Message.GetMemoMention()
260				if payload != nil {
261					memoIDs = append(memoIDs, payload.MemoId, payload.RelatedMemoId)
262				}
263			default:
264				// Ignore notification types without memo references.
265			}
266		}
267		return memoIDs
268	}

315		}

317			return viewer != nil
318		}
319		return true

92	// resolveSigningKey returns the raw HMAC key for a signing secret. Secrets using

107		if request.Webhook == nil {

118		if err != nil {

120		}
121		if currentUser == nil {
122			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
123		}
124		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
125			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
126		}
127	
128		// Get existing webhooks
129		webhooks, err := s.Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, userID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user webhooks: %v", err)
132		}
133	
134		// Find the webhook to update
135		var targetWebhook *storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook
136		for _, webhook := range webhooks {
137			if webhook.Id == webhookID {
138				targetWebhook = webhook
139				break
140			}
141		}
142	
143		if targetWebhook == nil {
144			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "webhook not found")
145		}
146	
147		// Update the webhook
148		updatedWebhook := &storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook{
149			Id:            webhookID,
150			Title:         targetWebhook.Title,
151			Url:           targetWebhook.Url,
152			SigningSecret: targetWebhook.SigningSecret,
153		}
154	
155		if request.UpdateMask != nil {
156			for _, path := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
157				switch path {
158				case "url":
159					if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
160						trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
161						if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
162							return nil, err
163						}
164						updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
165					}
166				case "display_name":
167					updatedWebhook.Title = request.Webhook.DisplayName
168				case "signing_secret":
169					secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
170					if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
171						return nil, err
172					}
173					updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
174				default:
175					// Ignore unsupported fields
176				}
177			}
178		} else {
179			// If no update mask is provided, update all fields
180			if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
181				trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
182				if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
183					return nil, err
184				}
185				updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
186			}
187			updatedWebhook.Title = request.Webhook.DisplayName
188			if request.Webhook.SigningSecret != "" {
189				secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
190				if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
191					return nil, err
192				}
193				updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
194			}
195		}
196	
197		err = s.Store.UpdateUserWebhook(ctx, userID, updatedWebhook)
198		if err != nil {
199			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update webhook: %v", err)
200		}
201	
202		return convertUserWebhookFromUserSetting(updatedWebhook, user), nil
203	}

18	var ErrInternalIP = errors.New("internal IP addresses are not allowed")

31	func newHTTPClient() *http.Client {
32		transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
33		transport.Proxy = nil
34		transport.DialContext = secureDialContext
35	
36		return &http.Client{
37			Transport: transport,
38			Timeout:   5 * time.Second,
39			CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
40				if err := validateURL(req.URL.String()); err != nil {
41					return errors.Wrap(err, "redirect to internal IP")
42				}
43				if len(via) >= 10 {
44					return errors.New("too many redirects")
45				}
46				return nil
47			},
48		}
49	}

51	func secureDialContext(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
52		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(address)
53		if err != nil {
54			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "invalid address")
55		}
56	
57		ips, err := resolveAllowedIPs(ctx, host)
58		if err != nil {
59			return nil, err
60		}
61	
62		var dialErr error
63		for _, ip := range ips {
64			conn, err := dialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(ip.String(), port))
65			if err == nil {
66				return conn, nil
67			}
68			dialErr = err
69		}
70		return nil, dialErr
71	}

73	func resolveAllowedIPs(ctx context.Context, host string) ([]net.IP, error) {
74		if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil {
75			if isInternalIP(ip) {
76				return nil, errors.Wrap(ErrInternalIP, ip.String())
77			}
78			return []net.IP{ip}, nil
79		}
80	
81		addrs, err := lookupIPAddr(ctx, host)
82		if err != nil {
83			return nil, errors.Errorf("failed to resolve hostname: %v", err)
84		}
85	
86		ips := make([]net.IP, 0, len(addrs))
87		for _, addr := range addrs {
88			ip := addr.IP
89			if ip == nil {
90				continue
91			}
92			if isInternalIP(ip) {
93				return nil, errors.Wrapf(ErrInternalIP, "host=%s, ip=%s", host, ip.String())
94			}
95			ips = append(ips, ip)
96		}
97		if len(ips) == 0 {
98			return nil, errors.New("hostname resolved to no addresses")
99		}
100	
101		return ips, nil
102	}

104	func isInternalIP(ip net.IP) bool {
105		return ip.IsLoopback() || ip.IsPrivate() || ip.IsLinkLocalUnicast() || ip.IsUnspecified()
106	}

108	func validateURL(urlStr string) error {
109		u, err := url.Parse(urlStr)
110		if err != nil {
111			return errors.New("invalid URL format")
112		}
113	
114		if u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https" {
115			return errors.New("only http/https protocols are allowed")
116		}
117	
118		host := u.Hostname()
119		if host == "" {
120			return errors.New("empty hostname")
121		}
122	
123		if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil && isInternalIP(ip) {
124			return errors.Wrap(ErrInternalIP, ip.String())
125		}
126	
127		return nil
128	}

130	type HTMLMeta struct {

132		Description string `json:"description"`
133		Image       string `json:"image"`
134	}

136	func GetHTMLMeta(urlStr string) (*HTMLMeta, error) {
137		if err := validateURL(urlStr); err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140	
141		response, err := httpClient.Get(urlStr)
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, err
144		}
145		defer response.Body.Close()
146	
147		mediatype, err := getMediatype(response)
148		if err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151		if mediatype != "text/html" {
152			return nil, errors.New("not a HTML page")
153		}
154	
155		htmlMeta := extractHTMLMeta(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maxHTMLMetaBytes))
156		enrichSiteMeta(response.Request.URL, htmlMeta)
157		return htmlMeta, nil

160	func extractHTMLMeta(resp io.Reader) *HTMLMeta {
161		tokenizer := html.NewTokenizer(resp)
162		htmlMeta := new(HTMLMeta)
163	
164		for {
165			tokenType := tokenizer.Next()
166			if tokenType == html.ErrorToken {
167				break
168			} else if tokenType == html.StartTagToken || tokenType == html.SelfClosingTagToken {
169				token := tokenizer.Token()
170				if token.DataAtom == atom.Body {
171					break
172				}
173	
174				if token.DataAtom == atom.Title {
175					tokenizer.Next()
176					token := tokenizer.Token()
177					htmlMeta.Title = token.Data
178				} else if token.DataAtom == atom.Meta {
179					ogTitle, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "og:title")
180					if ok {
181						htmlMeta.Title = ogTitle
182					}
183	
184					ogDescription, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "og:description")
185					if ok {
186						htmlMeta.Description = ogDescription
187					}
188	
189					ogImage, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "og:image")
190					if ok {
191						htmlMeta.Image = ogImage
192					}
193	
194					description, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "description")
195					if ok && htmlMeta.Description == "" {
196						htmlMeta.Description = description
197					}
198				}
199			}
200		}
201	
202		return htmlMeta
203	}

205	func extractMetaProperty(token html.Token, prop string) (content string, ok bool) {
206		content, ok = "", false
207		for _, attr := range token.Attr {
208			if (attr.Key == "property" || attr.Key == "name") && strings.EqualFold(attr.Val, prop) {
209				ok = true
210			}
211			if attr.Key == "content" {
212				content = attr.Val
213			}
214		}

218	func enrichSiteMeta(url *url.URL, meta *HTMLMeta) {

55				slog.Int64("inbox_id", int64(inbox.ID)),
56				slog.Int64("receiver_id", int64(inbox.ReceiverID)))

58		}
59	
60		receiver, err := d.store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{ID: &inbox.ReceiverID})

62			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get notification receiver")
63		}
64		if receiver == nil || strings.TrimSpace(receiver.Email) == "" {
65			return nil
66		}
67	
68		sender, err := d.store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{ID: &inbox.SenderID})

136	func (d *EmailDispatcher) buildInboxEmailMessage(inbox *store.Inbox, receiver *store.User, sender *store.User, memosByID map[int32]*store.Memo) (*email.Message, error) {
137		senderName := displayNameForEmail(sender)

148	func (d *EmailDispatcher) buildMemoCommentEmailMessage(message *storepb.InboxMessage, receiver *store.User, senderName string, memosByID map[int32]*store.Memo) (*email.Message, error) {
149		payload := message.GetMemoComment()

159		if url == "" {

161		}
162

167			"",
168			"Open in Memos:",
169			url,
170			"",
171			"You are receiving this because you own this memo.",
172		}
173	
174		return &email.Message{

176			Subject: fmt.Sprintf("[Memos] %s commented on your memo", senderName),
177			Body:    strings.Join(body, "\n"),
178		}, nil
179	}

213	func (d *EmailDispatcher) listMemosByID(ctx context.Context, memoIDs []int32) (map[int32]*store.Memo, error) {
214		if len(memoIDs) == 0 {
215			return map[int32]*store.Memo{}, nil
216		}
217	
218		uniqueMemoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memoIDs))
219		seenMemoIDs := make(map[int32]struct{}, len(memoIDs))
220		for _, memoID := range memoIDs {
221			if memoID == 0 {
222				continue
223			}
224			if _, seen := seenMemoIDs[memoID]; seen {
225				continue
226			}
227			seenMemoIDs[memoID] = struct{}{}
228			uniqueMemoIDs = append(uniqueMemoIDs, memoID)
229		}
230		if len(uniqueMemoIDs) == 0 {
231			return map[int32]*store.Memo{}, nil
232		}
233	
234		memos, err := d.store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{IDList: uniqueMemoIDs})
235		if err != nil {
236			return nil, err
237		}
238	
239		memosByID := make(map[int32]*store.Memo, len(memos))
240		for _, memo := range memos {
241			memosByID[memo.ID] = memo
242		}
243		return memosByID, nil
244	}

246	func collectInboxMemoIDs(inboxes []*store.Inbox) []int32 {
247		memoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(inboxes)*2)
248		for _, inbox := range inboxes {
249			if inbox == nil || inbox.Message == nil {
250				continue
251			}
252			switch inbox.Message.Type {
253			case storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT:
254				payload := inbox.Message.GetMemoComment()
255				if payload != nil {
256					memoIDs = append(memoIDs, payload.MemoId, payload.RelatedMemoId)
257				}
258			case storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_MENTION:
259				payload := inbox.Message.GetMemoMention()
260				if payload != nil {
261					memoIDs = append(memoIDs, payload.MemoId, payload.RelatedMemoId)
262				}
263			default:
264				// Ignore notification types without memo references.
265			}
266		}
267		return memoIDs
268	}

315		}

317			return viewer != nil
318		}
319		return true

54		// Authentication Method 1: Password-based authentication
55		if passwordCredentials := request.GetPasswordCredentials(); passwordCredentials != nil {

68			}
69			instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
70			if err != nil {
71				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
72			}
73			// Check if the password auth in is allowed.
74			if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowPasswordAuth && user.Role == store.RoleUser {
75				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "password signin is not allowed")

19	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOUser(ctx context.Context, currentUser *store.User, identityProvider *storepb.IdentityProvider, userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo) (*store.User, error) {
20		provider := identityProvider.Uid
21		externUID := userInfo.Identifier
22	
23		user, err := s.getLinkedSSOUser(ctx, provider, externUID)
24		if err != nil {
25			return nil, err
26		}
27		if user != nil {
28			if currentUser != nil && currentUser.ID != user.ID {
29				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider account is already linked to another user")
30			}
31			return user, nil
32		}
33	
34		if currentUser != nil {
35			return s.bindSSOIdentityToUser(ctx, currentUser, provider, externUID)
36		}
37	
38		// Miss path: enforce the registration gate before creating anything.
39		instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
40		if err != nil {
41			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
42		}
43		if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowUserRegistration {
44			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "user registration is not allowed")
45		}
46	
47		password, err := util.RandomString(20)
48		if err != nil {
49			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate random password, error: %v", err)
50		}
51		passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
52		if err != nil {
53			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash, error: %v", err)
54		}
55		username, err := deriveSSOUsername()
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to derive username, error: %v", err)
58		}
59		user, err = s.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{
60			Username:     username,
61			Role:         store.RoleUser,
62			Nickname:     userInfo.DisplayName,
63			Email:        userInfo.Email,
64			AvatarURL:    userInfo.AvatarURL,
65			PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
66		})
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user, error: %v", err)
69		}
70	
71		if _, err := s.Store.CreateUserIdentity(ctx, &store.UserIdentity{
72			UserID:    user.ID,
73			Provider:  provider,
74			ExternUID: externUID,
75		}); err != nil {
76			// Best-effort cleanup: the provisional user row has no linkage and should not remain.
77			_, _ = s.Store.DeleteUser(ctx, &store.DeleteUser{ID: user.ID})
78			if isUniqueConstraintViolation(err) {
79				// Concurrent first login won the race; load the winning linkage's user.
80				winner, getErr := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
81					Provider:  &provider,
82					ExternUID: &externUID,
83				})
84				if getErr != nil {
85					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to reload user identity after race, error: %v", getErr)
86				}
87				if winner == nil {
88					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "user identity conflict reported but no winning row found")
89				}
90				winnerUser, getErr := s.Store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{ID: &winner.UserID})
91				if getErr != nil {
92					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user after race, error: %v", getErr)
93				}
94				if winnerUser == nil {
95					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "linked user %d not found after race", winner.UserID)
96				}
97				return winnerUser, nil
98			}
99			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user identity, error: %v", err)
100		}
101		return user, nil
102	}

104	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOIdentity(ctx context.Context, idpName, code, redirectURI, codeVerifier string) (*storepb.IdentityProvider, *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo, error) {
105		idpUID, err := ExtractIdentityProviderUIDFromName(idpName)
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid identity provider name: %v", err)
108		}
109		identityProvider, err := s.Store.GetIdentityProvider(ctx, &store.FindIdentityProvider{
110			UID: &idpUID,
111		})
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get identity provider, error: %v", err)
114		}
115		if identityProvider == nil {
116			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "identity provider not found")
117		}
118	
119		var userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo
120		if identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2 {
121			oauth2IdentityProvider, err := oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(identityProvider.Config.GetOauth2Config())
122			if err != nil {
123				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create oauth2 identity provider, error: %v", err)
124			}
125			// Pass code_verifier for PKCE support (empty string if not provided for backward compatibility)
126			token, err := oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURI, code, codeVerifier)
127			if err != nil {
128				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to exchange token, error: %v", err)
129			}
130			userInfo, err = oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo(ctx, token)
131			if err != nil {
132				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user info, error: %v", err)
133			}
134		}
135	
136		identifierFilter := identityProvider.IdentifierFilter
137		if identifierFilter != "" {
138			identifierFilterRegex, err := regexp.Compile(identifierFilter)
139			if err != nil {
140				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to compile identifier filter regex, error: %v", err)
141			}
142			if !identifierFilterRegex.MatchString(userInfo.Identifier) {
143				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "identifier %s is not allowed", userInfo.Identifier)
144			}
145		}
146	
147		return identityProvider, userInfo, nil
148	}

171	func (s *APIV1Service) bindSSOIdentityToUser(ctx context.Context, currentUser *store.User, provider, externUID string) (*store.User, error) {
172		existingForProvider, err := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
173			UserID:   &currentUser.ID,
174			Provider: &provider,
175		})
176		if err != nil {
177			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get existing linked identity, error: %v", err)
178		}
179		if existingForProvider != nil {
180			if existingForProvider.ExternUID == externUID {
181				return currentUser, nil
182			}
183			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider is already linked to another external account for this user")
184		}
185	
186		if _, err := s.Store.CreateUserIdentity(ctx, &store.UserIdentity{
187			UserID:    currentUser.ID,
188			Provider:  provider,
189			ExternUID: externUID,
190		}); err != nil {
191			if isUniqueConstraintViolation(err) {
192				winner, getErr := s.getLinkedSSOUser(ctx, provider, externUID)
193				if getErr != nil {
194					return nil, getErr
195				}
196				if winner != nil {
197					if winner.ID != currentUser.ID {
198						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider account is already linked to another user")
199					}
200					return currentUser, nil
201				}
202	
203				existingForProvider, getErr := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
204					UserID:   &currentUser.ID,
205					Provider: &provider,
206				})
207				if getErr != nil {
208					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to reload linked identity after race, error: %v", getErr)
209				}
210				if existingForProvider != nil {
211					if existingForProvider.ExternUID == externUID {
212						return currentUser, nil
213					}
214					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider is already linked to another external account for this user")
215				}
216	
217				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "user identity conflict reported but no winning row found")
218			}
219			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user identity, error: %v", err)
220		}
221		return currentUser, nil
222	}

224	// isUniqueConstraintViolation matches the driver-specific error messages that each
225	// supported backend emits when any UNIQUE constraint rejects an insert. Callers
226	// disambiguate which constraint was hit from the insertion context (e.g. inserting
227	// a user_identity row can only violate UNIQUE(provider, extern_uid); inserting a
228	// user row can only violate UNIQUE(username)). Matches the pattern used in

230	func isUniqueConstraintViolation(err error) bool {

236			strings.Contains(msg, "duplicate key") ||

54		// Authentication Method 1: Password-based authentication
55		if passwordCredentials := request.GetPasswordCredentials(); passwordCredentials != nil {

68			}
69			instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
70			if err != nil {
71				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
72			}
73			// Check if the password auth in is allowed.
74			if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowPasswordAuth && user.Role == store.RoleUser {
75				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "password signin is not allowed")

19	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOUser(ctx context.Context, currentUser *store.User, identityProvider *storepb.IdentityProvider, userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo) (*store.User, error) {
20		provider := identityProvider.Uid
21		externUID := userInfo.Identifier
22	
23		user, err := s.getLinkedSSOUser(ctx, provider, externUID)
24		if err != nil {
25			return nil, err
26		}
27		if user != nil {
28			if currentUser != nil && currentUser.ID != user.ID {
29				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider account is already linked to another user")
30			}
31			return user, nil
32		}
33	
34		if currentUser != nil {
35			return s.bindSSOIdentityToUser(ctx, currentUser, provider, externUID)
36		}
37	
38		// Miss path: enforce the registration gate before creating anything.
39		instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
40		if err != nil {
41			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
42		}
43		if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowUserRegistration {
44			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "user registration is not allowed")
45		}
46	
47		password, err := util.RandomString(20)
48		if err != nil {
49			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate random password, error: %v", err)
50		}
51		passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
52		if err != nil {
53			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash, error: %v", err)
54		}
55		username, err := deriveSSOUsername()
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to derive username, error: %v", err)
58		}
59		user, err = s.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{
60			Username:     username,
61			Role:         store.RoleUser,
62			Nickname:     userInfo.DisplayName,
63			Email:        userInfo.Email,
64			AvatarURL:    userInfo.AvatarURL,
65			PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
66		})
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user, error: %v", err)
69		}
70	
71		if _, err := s.Store.CreateUserIdentity(ctx, &store.UserIdentity{
72			UserID:    user.ID,
73			Provider:  provider,
74			ExternUID: externUID,
75		}); err != nil {
76			// Best-effort cleanup: the provisional user row has no linkage and should not remain.
77			_, _ = s.Store.DeleteUser(ctx, &store.DeleteUser{ID: user.ID})
78			if isUniqueConstraintViolation(err) {
79				// Concurrent first login won the race; load the winning linkage's user.
80				winner, getErr := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
81					Provider:  &provider,
82					ExternUID: &externUID,
83				})
84				if getErr != nil {
85					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to reload user identity after race, error: %v", getErr)
86				}
87				if winner == nil {
88					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "user identity conflict reported but no winning row found")
89				}
90				winnerUser, getErr := s.Store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{ID: &winner.UserID})
91				if getErr != nil {
92					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user after race, error: %v", getErr)
93				}
94				if winnerUser == nil {
95					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "linked user %d not found after race", winner.UserID)
96				}
97				return winnerUser, nil
98			}
99			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user identity, error: %v", err)
100		}
101		return user, nil
102	}

104	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOIdentity(ctx context.Context, idpName, code, redirectURI, codeVerifier string) (*storepb.IdentityProvider, *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo, error) {
105		idpUID, err := ExtractIdentityProviderUIDFromName(idpName)
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid identity provider name: %v", err)
108		}
109		identityProvider, err := s.Store.GetIdentityProvider(ctx, &store.FindIdentityProvider{
110			UID: &idpUID,
111		})
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get identity provider, error: %v", err)
114		}
115		if identityProvider == nil {
116			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "identity provider not found")
117		}
118	
119		var userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo
120		if identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2 {
121			oauth2IdentityProvider, err := oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(identityProvider.Config.GetOauth2Config())
122			if err != nil {
123				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create oauth2 identity provider, error: %v", err)
124			}
125			// Pass code_verifier for PKCE support (empty string if not provided for backward compatibility)
126			token, err := oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURI, code, codeVerifier)
127			if err != nil {
128				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to exchange token, error: %v", err)
129			}
130			userInfo, err = oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo(ctx, token)
131			if err != nil {
132				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user info, error: %v", err)
133			}
134		}
135	
136		identifierFilter := identityProvider.IdentifierFilter
137		if identifierFilter != "" {
138			identifierFilterRegex, err := regexp.Compile(identifierFilter)
139			if err != nil {
140				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to compile identifier filter regex, error: %v", err)
141			}
142			if !identifierFilterRegex.MatchString(userInfo.Identifier) {
143				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "identifier %s is not allowed", userInfo.Identifier)
144			}
145		}
146	
147		return identityProvider, userInfo, nil
148	}

171	func (s *APIV1Service) bindSSOIdentityToUser(ctx context.Context, currentUser *store.User, provider, externUID string) (*store.User, error) {
172		existingForProvider, err := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
173			UserID:   &currentUser.ID,
174			Provider: &provider,
175		})
176		if err != nil {
177			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get existing linked identity, error: %v", err)
178		}
179		if existingForProvider != nil {
180			if existingForProvider.ExternUID == externUID {
181				return currentUser, nil
182			}
183			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider is already linked to another external account for this user")
184		}
185	
186		if _, err := s.Store.CreateUserIdentity(ctx, &store.UserIdentity{
187			UserID:    currentUser.ID,
188			Provider:  provider,
189			ExternUID: externUID,
190		}); err != nil {
191			if isUniqueConstraintViolation(err) {
192				winner, getErr := s.getLinkedSSOUser(ctx, provider, externUID)
193				if getErr != nil {
194					return nil, getErr
195				}
196				if winner != nil {
197					if winner.ID != currentUser.ID {
198						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider account is already linked to another user")
199					}
200					return currentUser, nil
201				}
202	
203				existingForProvider, getErr := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
204					UserID:   &currentUser.ID,
205					Provider: &provider,
206				})
207				if getErr != nil {
208					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to reload linked identity after race, error: %v", getErr)
209				}
210				if existingForProvider != nil {
211					if existingForProvider.ExternUID == externUID {
212						return currentUser, nil
213					}
214					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider is already linked to another external account for this user")
215				}
216	
217				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "user identity conflict reported but no winning row found")
218			}
219			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user identity, error: %v", err)
220		}
221		return currentUser, nil
222	}

224	// isUniqueConstraintViolation matches the driver-specific error messages that each
225	// supported backend emits when any UNIQUE constraint rejects an insert. Callers
226	// disambiguate which constraint was hit from the insertion context (e.g. inserting
227	// a user_identity row can only violate UNIQUE(provider, extern_uid); inserting a
228	// user row can only violate UNIQUE(username)). Matches the pattern used in

230	func isUniqueConstraintViolation(err error) bool {

236			strings.Contains(msg, "duplicate key") ||

## Final Report: Third-Party Identity Provider Integration

Based on my thorough exploration of the codebase, here's a comprehensive summary of the identity provider architecture:

### **Package Structure & Main Abstractions**

1. **`/bench/repo/internal/idp/`** - Core identity provider abstraction layer
   - **`/bench/repo/internal/idp/idp.go`** - Base abstraction defining `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct (shared data model)
     - `Identifier` (required: unique external user ID)
     - `DisplayName`, `Email`, `AvatarURL` (optional profile fields)

2. **`/bench/repo/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`** - OAuth2 protocol implementation
   - **`IdentityProvider` struct** - OAuth2-specific provider implementation
   - **Key methods:**
     - `NewIdentityProvider(config *storepb.OAuth2Config)` - Factory function with validation
     - `ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURL, code, codeVerifier string)` - Token exchange with PKCE support
     - `UserInfo(ctx, token string)` - Fetch user info via OAuth2 token with configurable field mapping

### **Storage & Data Models**

3. **`/bench/repo/store/idp.go`** - Store-level identity provider operations
   - **`IdentityProvider` struct** (store model):
     - ID, UID (unique identifier), Name, Type, IdentifierFilter, Config
   - **Operations:** Create, List, Get, Update, Delete
   - **Dual-source design:** Database-backed + deployment configuration shadowing

4. **`/bench/repo/store/user_identity.go`** - External identity linkage
   - **`UserIdentity` struct** - Links external identities to local users
     - UserID, Provider, ExternUID (unique on provider+externUID)
     - Supports multiple external identities per user across different providers

5. **Database implementations:**
   - `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/idp.go`
   - `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/idp.go`
   - `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/idp.go`

### **Provider Type Support**

6. **Protobuf definitions** (`/bench/repo/proto/store/idp.proto` & `/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/idp_service.proto`):
   - **Currently supported:** `OAUTH2` only
   - **Type enum:** `IdentityProvider_Type {TYPE_UNSPECIFIED=0; OAUTH2=1}`
   - **Config union:** `IdentityProviderConfig {oneof config {OAuth2Config oauth2_config=1}}`

### **OAuth2 Configuration Schema**

**`OAuth2Config` message includes:**
- `client_id`, `client_secret` (required)
- `auth_url`, `token_url`, `user_info_url` (required, must be absolute HTTPS URLs)
- `scopes` (required array)
- `field_mapping` (required):
  - `identifier` (required: maps to user's unique external ID)
  - `display_name`, `email`, `avatar_url` (optional mappings from OAuth2 userinfo response)

### **API Service Layer**

7. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/idp_service.go`** - gRPC/HTTP API for IDP management
   - `ListIdentityProviders()` - List all providers
   - `GetIdentityProvider()` - Retrieve by resource name
   - `CreateIdentityProvider()` - Admin-only creation
   - `UpdateIdentityProvider()` - Admin-only mutation with field masking
   - `DeleteIdentityProvider()` - Admin-only deletion with safety validation

8. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`** - Authentication flows
   - **`SignIn()` method** supports dual credentials:
     - `PasswordCredentials` (username+password) - Traditional auth
     - `SSOCredentials` (idp_name + code + redirect_uri + code_verifier) - OAuth2 flow

9. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go`** - SSO-specific logic
   - **`resolveSSOIdentity()`** - Validates OAuth2 code with provider, fetches userinfo
   - **`resolveSSOUser()`** - Creates/links user identity with race condition handling
   - **`getLinkedSSOUser()`** - Lookup via user_identity table
   - **`bindSSOIdentityToUser()`** - Link additional provider to existing user

### **Configuration Sources & Deployment Support**

10. **Deployment configuration** (`/bench/repo/store/deployment_config.go`):
    - **File pattern:** `memos-idp-*.json` in `/etc/secrets/`
    - **Validated constraints:**
      - Type restricted to `OAUTH2`
      - All required fields mandatory
      - UID must match base.UIDMatcher pattern
      - Optional regex `identifier_filter` for access control
      - Provider validation prevents unsafe auth states (e.g., password disabled with no IDP)

11. **Authentication state safety** (`/bench/repo/store/auth_config.go`):
    - **`DeleteIdentityProviderSafely()`** - Validates deletion won't lock users out
    - **`ErrUnsafeAuthenticationConfiguration`** - Prevents disabling password auth when no IDP available

### **Key Features**

- **PKCE Support:** OAuth2 code exchange includes PKCE code_verifier handling
- **Field Mapping:** Configurable extraction of user properties from OAuth2 userinfo endpoint
- **Identifier Filtering:** Regex-based access control on external user IDs
- **Race Condition Handling:** Concurrent first-login scenarios handled via unique constraint on (provider, extern_uid)
- **Multi-Provider Support:** Single user can link to multiple identity providers
- **Deployment vs. Runtime:** Deployment-configured providers shadow database-backed ones

### **Resource Naming Convention**

- API resource format: `identity-providers/{idp}` (where `{idp}` is the UID)
- Proto enum and conversion handling for type marshaling/unmarshaling

All third-party authentication routes through the OAuth2 abstraction layer with configurable field mapping, making it extensible for additional OAuth2 providers (Google, GitHub, custom OIDC) without code changes—only configuration.</result>

21	// NewTestingStore creates a new testing store with a fresh database.
22	// Each test gets its own isolated database:
23	//   - SQLite: new temp file per test
24	//   - MySQL/PostgreSQL: new database per test in shared container
25	func NewTestingStore(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T) *store.Store {
26		driver := getDriverFromEnv()
27		profile := getTestingProfileForDriver(t, driver)
28		dbDriver, err := db.NewDBDriver(profile)
29		if err != nil {
30			t.Fatalf("failed to create db driver: %v", err)
31		}
32	
33		store := store.New(dbDriver, profile)
34		if err := store.Migrate(ctx); err != nil {
35			t.Fatalf("failed to migrate db: %v", err)
36		}
37		return store
38	}

45		}

131	// serveAttachmentFile serves attachment binary content using native HTTP.
132	func (s *FileServerService) serveAttachmentFile(c *echo.Context) error {
133		ctx := c.Request().Context()
134		uid := c.Param("uid")
135		wantThumbnail := c.QueryParam("thumbnail") == "true"
136		wantMotion := c.QueryParam("motion") == "true"
137	
138		attachment, err := s.Store.GetAttachment(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
139			UID:     &uid,
140			GetBlob: true,
141		})
142		if err != nil {
143			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment").Wrap(err)
144		}
145		if attachment == nil {
146			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "attachment not found")
147		}
148	
149		if err := s.checkAttachmentPermission(ctx, c, attachment); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152	
153		if wantMotion {
154			return s.serveMotionClip(c, attachment)
155		}
156	
157		contentType := s.sanitizeContentType(attachment.Type)
158	
159		// Stream video/audio to avoid loading entire file into memory.
160		if isMediaType(attachment.Type) {
161			return s.serveMediaStream(c, attachment, contentType)
162		}
163	
164		return s.serveStaticFile(c, attachment, contentType, wantThumbnail)
165	}

169		ctx := c.Request().Context()
170	
171		// On a private instance (no InstanceURL), avatars are not exposed to anonymous
172		// visitors; a valid session, access token, or PAT is required.
173		if !s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
174			viewer, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
175			if err != nil {
176				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
177			}
178			if viewer == nil {
179				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
180			}
181		}
182	
183		identifier := c.Param("identifier")
184	
185		user, err := s.getUserByUsername(ctx, identifier)
186		if err != nil {
187			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get user").Wrap(err)
188		}
189		if user == nil {
190			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "user not found")
191		}
192		if user.AvatarURL == "" {
193			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "avatar not found")
194		}
195	
196		imageType, imageData, err := s.parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)
197		if err != nil {
198			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to parse avatar data").Wrap(err)
199		}

201		if !avatarAllowedTypes[imageType] {
202			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid avatar image type")

205		setSecurityHeaders(c)
206		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentType, imageType)
207		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderCacheControl, cacheMaxAge)
208	
209		return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, imageType, imageData)
210	}

216	// serveMediaStream serves video/audio files using streaming to avoid memory exhaustion.
217	func (s *FileServerService) serveMediaStream(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string) error {
218		setSecurityHeaders(c)
219		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
220	
221		switch attachment.StorageType {
222		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
223			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
224			if err != nil {
225				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
226			}
227			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
228			return nil
229	
230		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
231			presignURL, err := s.getS3PresignedURL(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
232			if err != nil {
233				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to generate presigned URL").Wrap(err)
234			}
235			return c.Redirect(http.StatusTemporaryRedirect, presignURL)
236	
237		default:
238			// Database storage fallback.
239			modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
240			http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.Filename, modTime, bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob))
241			return nil
242		}
243	}
